item.title: Build 694
item.description: • Hand a todo to Claude. Hover a todo and press the paper plane, or right-click it, and Mayfly copies it as a prompt and brings Claude forward for you to paste into the right chat. The prompt carries the todo, what was said and where, its owner and deadline, and, if you choose "with Project Brief", what Mayfly knows about the project. It asks Claude to say how it would go about it before changing anything. Todos from notes kept out of AI are never offered, and email addresses are replaced. Nothing is sent by Mayfly itself: Claude's desktop app has no way for another app to pick a chat, so you choose it.
